constrained_softplus.map: kappa = kappa0 * softplus(beta*theta)/softplus(beta), theta starts at 1

sensitivity.coordinates: x_i = (p_i - p_opt_i)/scale_i, scale = nominal (mean initial guess)

thickness_transfer_direction.definition: d1 up, d2 down at constant n1 d1 and n2 d2, in nominal-scaled coordinates

singular_value_table.label: singular values s_k of J/sqrt(L) (= square roots of the eigenvalues of G = J^T J / L), J = dy/dx in nominal-scaled coordinates x_i = (p_i - p_i^opt)/p_i^nom; p^nom = mean of the three starts; components of the right singular vector (sign fixed so that the largest component is positive); listed components |v_i| >= 0.25
